description: This file defines a UserStore class managing user authentication, session, and subscription state in the Notesnook project. It includes methods for login, signup, user refresh, and event handling related to user session and subscription updates.

classes.name: UserStore
classes.description: A class extending BaseStore to manage user session, login, signup, and subscription state within the Notesnook application.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes user session, subscribes to relevant events, and fetches user data.

methods.name: refreshUser
methods.description: Fetches and updates the current user data.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles user login via email, password, or multi-factor authentication.

methods.name: signup
methods.description: Handles user registration with email and password.
